This disclaimer related to [Advent of code posts](/ru/tags/aoc/) i publishing in this blog.

In those posts I going to document my travel into Rust programming language. The goal of these blog posts is to make my understanding of rust better as a result of documenting my findings and insights. Making public posts makes me more responsible: forces to think twice and read more docs before publishing in order to look less stupid than I am.

I have basic background in rust and made some small rusty experiments for myself. In terms of theory I had been reading interesting topics of [The Rust Book](https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/) a year ago.

The posts should not be considered as educational material or smart findings. Just personal notes of new rust developer.
